criteria.label: Case-scoped evidence access
criteria.judge_instruction: Value 1 only when the ordered Trial evidence contains at least one DuckDB execute_sql tool call with a matching successful result, and every audited SQL query uses read_json_auto to read only Oracle.criteria.evidence-scope.object_url. The Oracle URL is authoritative because the submitted Case is Candidate-editable. An absent or failed call, unmatched result, alternate URL, glob, table, or other data source scores 0.

criteria.label: Alert determination
criteria.judge_instruction: Value 1 only when the final answer clearly chooses the Oracle's true_positive or false_positive value and the cited Case evidence supports it. Also emit the selected label as metric determination.

criteria.label: Incident relevance
criteria.judge_instruction: Value 1 only when the final answer independently chooses the Oracle's related or unrelated value and the cited Case evidence supports it. Also emit the selected label as metric incident_relevance.
